description: ECHOES: Beyond the Mission is a NASA Space Apps 2026 project led by a 17-year-old student from Peru. I am currently its sole member, learning web development as I build an interactive bilingual experience. Using verified NASA sources, the project will tell the stories of equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars, highlighting the science and people behind each mission. I aim to combine research, careful design, and storytelling to show that a mission's impact can outlast its final signal.
